svg.aria-label: Hushh drop-off detection dashboard, a hackathon project that re-engages users with push and email flows.

g.text: Built with a small hackathon team: a system that flags users dropping off mid-flow on e-commerce
and SaaS platforms and re-engages them automatically through push notification and email recovery
flows. A React dashboard, a Node.js/Express/Firebase backend and a React Native app tied it all
